channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para Justiça Eleitoral investigar diretor da PF por beneficiar Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint with the Electoral Court requesting an investigation into the Director General of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, for suspected use of public infrastructure to benefit Lula. The accusation is related to the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: TSE investiga Marçal e site de cripto por suposto apoio irregular a Flávio
item.description: The TSE is investigating Pablo Marçal and the website Brasil 22 Token for suspected irregular support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the presidential campaign. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva accepted the request filed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidate for re-election. The investigation aims to verify possible violations of electoral rules regarding campaign funding and political advertising.

item.title: Autossuficiente, Justiça Eleitoral desfaz à tarde decisão da manhã
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques complained to STF president Edson Fachin about judicial interference in electoral matters. The autonomy of the Electoral Power was highlighted as a key issue. The correspondence reflects tensions between state powers in the electoral context.

item.title: Flávio passa domingo reunido com prefeitos e vereadores de São Paulo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, held a meeting in São Paulo with mayors and councilors from the metropolitan area, accompanied by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. During the event, he criticized Lula and highlighted the drop in future interest rates after the first round, promising public spending cuts without affecting social areas.

item.title: Equipe de Luan Santana diz que gesto em show não foi apoio a Lula
item.description: Luan Santana's press office denied that the gesture made during his show in Brasília was a political support to President Lula, stating it is a common gesture in all shows and has no political connotation. Fans interpreted the gesture as a 'L' sign supporting the presidential candidate, but the artist's team emphasized he does not take political positions. The show took place during the Registro Histórico tour amid high electoral polarization.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro informa Moraes sobre retomada das visitas de Flávio
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense informed the STF of resuming Flávio's visits after Moraes' 90-day suspension ended. The scheduling will proceed with the Military Police Custody Unit, respecting cautionary measures. The suspension occurred after Flávio shared Jair's letter on social media.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio acusa corregedor do TSE de favorecer Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) criticized the TSE corregedor's decision, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, for restoring the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', accusing the judge of favoring Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The senator's team labeled the decision as 'outrageous' and accused the corregedor of showing 'complacency with the dissemination of fake news' in favor of Lula. André Janones (Rede-MG), who manages the channel, was mentioned in the controversy.

item.title: Manifestantes pró-Lula depredam estações de metrô na Paulista, diz PM
item.description: Pro-Lula protesters vandalized metro stations on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo during a rally supporting the president. Military police reported riots and vandalism at Trianon-Masp and Paulista stations, leading to access closures. President Lula and several PT governors attended the event.

item.title: O Tribunal do Ofício Nada Santo de Kássio e Mendonça censura até a imprensa
item.description: STF and TSE ministers act as indirect press censorship, suppressing Lula campaign information under the guise of combating misinformation.

item.title: Mendonça proíbe PT de impulsionar vídeo sobre Flávio e escala 6×1
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça banned the PT from resharing a video accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of supporting the 6×1 scale, to prevent potential electoral irregularities. In a separate ruling, he ordered CUT to remove five anti-PL posts. The rulings aim to preserve neutrality and legality in the campaign.

item.title: Quando são os dias dos debates presidenciais do 2º turno das eleições 2026?
item.description: The presidential debates for the second round of the 2026 elections are scheduled for October 18 on Band and October 23 on Globo. There is hope that Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will attend, following absences and cancellations in the first round due to judicial decisions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro x Lula – Quem são os candidatos a presidente no segundo turno das eleições 2026
item.description: The second round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election will be contested between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), running for re-election, and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), representing Jair Bolsonaro's legacy and currently imprisoned for an attempted coup. Lula secured 45.16% of valid votes in the first round, while Flávio garnered 47.03%, keeping the race tightly balanced ahead of the October 25 runoff.

item.title: Em vídeo, Jorge Messias volta a pedir votos para Lula
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias posted a video on social media urging votes for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and stated that the end of the 6×1 scale will be approved, crediting this progress to President Lula. Messias emphasized the importance of the issue for workers who work six days a week.

item.title: CCJ do Senado vota PEC da Segurança na próxima quarta-feira (14/10)
item.description: The Senate's Committee on Constitution and Justice (CCJ) will vote next Wednesday (10/14) on the remaining three amendments to the Public Security Constitutional Amendment (PEC), which aims to reform the country's security system. The matter is a government priority for President Lula and marks a moment of rapprochement between the president and the Senate president, Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Flávio pede investigação contra diretor da PF por interferência eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro filed an electoral complaint against the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues over alleged election interference. The complaint stems from the disclosure of a preliminary investigation into possible foreign influence on election day, which Bolsonaro's defense claims boosted the PT. He requests the Electoral Public Ministry to lead the investigation and release documents from the AGU, PF, and PGR.

item.title: Defesa da democracia e virada de votos mobilizam ato com Lula na Paulista
item.description: Lula spoke at a pro-reelection rally on Paulista Avenue defending democracy and criticizing the Bolsonaro family, urging turnout among non-voters. Alckmin echoed support for the Constitution and the 1932 heroes.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio critica decisão que libera canal “Exército de Lula”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized the decision by the chief clerk of the Electoral Justice who suspended the removal of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, calling it indulgence toward fake news favorable to Lula. The channel, run by André Janones, resumed operations after a preliminary injunction granted by Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva.

item.title: Flávio aciona Justiça Eleitoral contra diretor-geral da PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team filed an electoral crime complaint with the Electoral Court against the director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, accusing him of using the agency's structure to benefit a political party during the first round of the 2026 election. The lawsuit stems from statements made by Andrei on October 4th, when he mentioned a potential foreign interference in the elections, despite no formal investigation being opened. Three days later, the Federal Police closed the preliminary investigation due to lack of minimal evidence of a crime.

item.title: Apoiadores realizam atos pró-Lula no país inteiro neste domingo (11/10)
item.description: Supporters of Lula held 156 events in 76 cities in support of his re-election campaign. The largest event took place on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, gathering 1 million people according to the PT campaign. The mobilization featured appearances by Geraldo Alckmin, Fernando Haddad, and several governors.

item.title: Luan Santana faz gesto com a mão em show e fãs falam em apoio a Lula
item.description: Luan Santana became a topic on social media after fans interpreted a hand gesture as support for Lula during his show in Brasília. The artist's team denied any political intent behind the gesture, but Santana has not yet commented on the matter.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede que diretor-geral da PF seja investigado por suposto benefício ao PT na eleição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested an investigation into the Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues for allegedly benefiting the PT in the elections. The criminal complaint was filed with the Electoral Court.

item.title: Cleitinho nega apoio a Alcolumbre em vídeo sobre 6 X 1
item.description: The elected governor of Minas Gerais, Cleitinho Azevedo, denied supporting Davi Alcolumbre after criticism of an institutional video regarding the vote on PEC 221/2019, highlighting his divergence with Flávio Bolsonaro, who opposes the measure.

item.title: Mendonça proíbe PT de impulsionar vídeo que diz que Flávio Bolsonaro é contra a escala 6x1
item.description: TSE vice-president André Mendonça barred Lula's campaign from promoting a video claiming Flávio Bolsonaro opposes the 6x1 work schedule. The preliminary ruling cited election laws banning paid negative advertising. Mendonça also ordered the CUT to remove five anti-Flávio videos, reinforcing restrictions on institutional profiles in electoral contexts.

item.title: Metrô fecha estação Trianon-Masp durante manifestação na Paulista
item.description: São Paulo Metro temporarily closed the Trianon-Masp station on Line 2-Green due to the large crowd gathered during a pro-reelection demonstration for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The closure aimed to manage passenger flow and prevent overcrowding using established security protocols for public events. Passengers were redirected to Consolação and Brigadeiro stations.

item.title: Lula diz que CCJ retomará PEC da Segurança na 4ª feira
item.description: Lula stated that the Senate's CCJ will resume voting on the Public Security PEC on Wednesday, which aims to establish a national security system and enhance federal action against organized crime. He also pressured the PL to take a stance on the 6x1 scale, emphasizing the PEC as a government priority in the second round of elections.

item.title: Tarcísio e Nunes confirmam ato pró-Flávio na Paulista, e prefeito nega disputa de público com Lula
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes confirmed a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally on Paulista Avenue. Nunes denied having clashed publicly with President Lula.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro abre denúncia contra diretor da PF por divulgar investigação contra a direita sem provas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed an electoral complaint against the head of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, accusing him of an electoral crime for publicly announcing an investigation into alleged foreign interference supporting the far right without evidence. The inquiry, disclosed during the first round, was suspended days later due to lack of evidence.

item.title: Ato pela reeleição de Lula leva milhares à Avenida Paulista
item.description: Thousands gathered on Paulista Avenue for a pro-Lula rally, backed by social movements, pop culture fans, and football fan groups. Lula emphasized the upcoming Senate vote on the 6x1 workweek and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's budget cuts, warning they would harm the poor.

item.title: Janones comemora manutenção de canal de Lula: ‘Ninguém cala a voz de um povo’
item.description: The corregidor-geral da Justiça Eleitoral, Ricardo Villas Bôas, reinstated the 'Exército do Lula' channel after its suspension by Kassio Nunes Marques. Janones praised the ruling, saying no one silences the voice of the people.

item.title: Corregedor derruba decisão que suspendeu canal Exército do Lula
item.description: The chief electoral clerk overturned the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel, reversing a prior ruling; the final decision will be reviewed by the TSE plenary.

item.title: Lula diz que votação do fim da 6x1 antes do segundo turno já está acordada com Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula states that the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 tax scale on fuels will be voted on before the second round of the 2026 elections, following an agreement with Alcolumbre. According to his statement, the matter has already been coordinated with the Senate president.

item.title: O que são 'fandoms', que se uniram por Lula e ganharam agradecimento em ato
item.description: At a rally on Paulista Avenue, Lula specifically thanked the 'Brazilian fandoms', acknowledging the organized mobilization of music fans who supported his re-election campaign. These volunteers leveraged their fanbases to expand the reach of the event and the PT's campaign.

item.title: Lula e Flávio participam de sabatinas; Senado pode votar PEC da 6x1
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participate in town halls and debates as the 2026 presidential runoff campaign gains momentum. The PEC for six arrives at the Senate for voting, as candidates intensify their public communication agenda.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio diz que candidato não acabará com aposentadoria
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), denied in a social media video that the presidential candidate intends to eliminate pensions, calling fake news messages warning about a possible loss of benefits. She emphasized that Flávio supports protecting retirees and reducing INSS lines, proposing the use of artificial intelligence to speed up service to beneficiaries. The statement occurs amid the electoral dispute and debate over the future of Social Security.

item.title: Relator no TSE reverte decisão de Kassio e libera canal de Janones
item.description: Supreme Electoral Court (TSE) minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva overturned a decision by the court's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, reinstating the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula'. Cueva deemed the evidence insufficient to justify suspending the group and referred the case to the full court.

item.title: Flávio propõe dar celular e fogão a trabalhador que fizer cursos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed a CPF-linked point system rewarding workers with electronics or cash for completing professional training courses. The plan aims to match worker skills with local job openings through collaboration with municipal and state governments.

item.title: Corregedor suspende decisão do presidente do TSE e reabilita ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: The TSE corregador Villas Bôas Cueva suspended the decision by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques to remove the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, reinstating the group supporting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ruling will be discussed in the TSE plenary.

item.title: Em ato na Paulista, Lula faz aceno a jovens e promete revolução tecnológica
item.description: Lula participated in a pro-reelection rally on Paulista Avenue and promised a technological revolution in a potential fourth term, emphasizing the importance of youth in political life. He also urged the elderly to vote in the runoff and criticized Jair Bolsonaro's management during the Covid-19 pandemic.

item.title: Flávio pede mais agilidade da Justiça Eleitoral contra “mentiras”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged the Electoral Justice to act faster against what he called 'lies' in Lula's campaign, referencing the 'Exército do Lula' group. The event was attended by the governor and mayor of São Paulo, as well as lawmakers. The TSE has already deemed the group's content as false.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE suspende preliminarmente decisão de Nunes Marques e libera canal 'Exército do Lula'; decisão final será do plenário
item.description: The General Rapporteur of the Electoral Justice, Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, provisionally suspended the decision of the President of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, who had ordered the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel. Nunes Marques acted on a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, arguing the channel spread content deemed false. Lula called the suspension absurd and questioned supposedly biased rulings by the TSE.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que canal da campanha de Lula no WhatsApp faz 'divulgação de mentiras em massa'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula's campaign of spreading lies through a WhatsApp channel, which was briefly suspended by the TSE. At an event in São Paulo, he denied cutting Bolsa Família and reaffirmed a real minimum wage increase.

item.title: O pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro a prefeitos paulistas no segundo turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) gathered mayors and councilors in São Paulo to strengthen his base ahead of the runoff, emphasizing a broad first-round win. Lula (PT) also visited the city, reiterating his new slogan and pushing for labor reforms. Both candidates focused on consolidating support ahead of the final stretch.

item.title: Relator no TSE derruba decisão de Nunes Marques e mantém no ar canal de Whatsapp 'Exército do Lula'
item.description: Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, TSE ombudsman, overturned Kassio Nunes Marques' decision suspending the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, following Flávio Bolsonaro's request. Cueva ordered the case to the plenary, keeping the channel active as Lula supporters share content. The group grew from 50,000 to over 3 million followers after the first round.

item.title: Ex-fundador do PT diz que metade dos metalúrgicos do ABC vai votar em Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Zé Maria, a former founding member of the PT, stated on a podcast that half of ABC metalworkers will vote for Flávio Bolsonaro due to disappointment with Lula. In a debate with José Genoino, he emphasized that workers support the PL not because they are 'idiots', but due to dissatisfaction with the PT leader. Genoino acknowledged that the PT's political project faces a historical crisis.

item.title: Lula saca a la calle una marea roja para emprender la remontada y ganar las elecciones
item.description: Following a partial setback in the first round, Lula mobilized a 'red tide' of young people, LGBTs, and progressives on Paulista Avenue, reaffirming his defense of democracy and promising to activate the 33 million abstentionists to reverse the election outcome. With only two weeks left, Lula's strategy aims to regain momentum through mass mobilization.

item.title: Canal de Janones é suspenso com 3,4 milhões; Tropa do Flávio tem 1,3 milhão
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' channel, created by Deputy André Janones to mobilize Lula supporters in the runoff, was suspended by the TSE with 3.4 million followers after disinformation accusations from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Meanwhile, the 'Tropa do Flávio', by Deputy Nikolas Ferreira, has 1.3 million followers. The gap between the channels reached 2.1 million followers.

item.title: Durante ato em SP, Lula diz confiar na votação pelo fim da escala 6×1 no Senado
item.description: At an event in São Paulo, President Lula expressed confidence that the Senate will vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 workweek schedule, criticizing opponents like Flávio Bolsonaro. He also emphasized the need to mobilize voters who abstained in the first round for the upcoming runoff.

item.title: “São Paulo não quer ditadura”, diz Alckmin sobre Flávio
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin publicly criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during an event with President Lula in São Paulo, stating that the state 'does not want dictatorship' and invoking the students killed in 1932 as symbols of resistance. Alckmin also attacked the alleged connection between Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master and criticized the film 'Dark Horse' as an attempt at electoral manipulation.

item.title: Governo Lula tenta driblar prazos para votar fim da 6 X 1
item.description: The Lula administration seeks to approve a constitutional amendment ending the 6 X 1 schedule in the Senate, aiming to expedite the process through a special calendar. The strategy involves submitting a request with 54 signatures to reduce the regimental procedure and enable voting in two rounds by mid-October, avoiding delays caused by the opposition. The proposal requires 49 favorable votes in each round for approval.

item.title: Flávio reúne Tarcísio e prefeitos em SP e diz esperar Justiça Eleitoral mais ágil contra fake news
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro meets with Tarcísio and mayors in São Paulo, calling for faster electoral justice action against fake news attributed to Lula's campaign.
